pageProps.seoDescription: Purrmep is a Legends of Idleon divinity god. All characters produce 2x more Divinity, and get 2x more Divinity EXP! Only 1 player can link to Purrmep. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +50% Boat Sailing speed and +50% Gaming Plant grow speed. Blessing: +3% Sailing Speed.
